paper_metadata.title: Outstanding high-temperature strength of novel Fe–Cr–Ni–Al–V ferritic alloys with hierarchical B2–NiAl precipitates

evidence.quote: Outstanding high-temperature strength of novel Fe – Cr – Ni – Al – V ferritic alloys with hierarchical B2 – NiAl precipitates

In this study, we developed the Fe – Cr – Ni – Al – V ferritic alloy and investigated the microstructural evolutions and mechanical properties as a function of vanadium contents in Fe – Cr – Ni – Al ferritic alloys.

It is observed that the mean radius of the B2 – NiAl precipitates gradually decrease from 56 nm to 30 nm with increasing of the Vanadium concentration.

It is observed that the mean radius of the B2 – NiAl precipitates gradually decrease from 56 nm to 30 nm with increasing of the Vanadium concentration.
In present study, the Fe23Zr6 nano particles inside the B2 – NiAl primary precipitates were observed in Fig. 5.

Therefore, we believe that the hierarchical precipitate structure, which consist of two-phase (B2 – NiAl and Fe23Zr6), could be a considerable factors to further enhance the mechanical properties at high-temperatures.
